answer: Each agent must occupy one numbered dune terrace and keep a calibrated zenith mirror that only that terrace may flash. An applicant locks 39 coins for three epochs on terrace D-27 and bolts a one-use silvered mirror, serial etched at intake, aimed at local zenith. At noon a clerk photographs the flash against the official solar staff and files the still with the serial. Verifiers accept only if the dune cadastre lists that serial once and the flash sits within 0.3° of the published zenith. A borrowed mirror or two names on one terrace slashes the lock and returns D-27 to auction.
